caption: fifteen seasons of rangers in one brawler - the anniversary crossover across time itself.
about: Power rangers: super legends (2007) is the franchise's fifteenth-anniversary crossover: play through eras of the show - mighty morphin through operation overdrive - as rangers pulled across time to fight a shared threat. The beat-em-up loop is straightforward, the roster is the whole point, and the co-op makes it a proper couch brawler.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
